svg.title: AI Car Diagnostic Assistant — Detailed Technical Architecture
svg.desc: Frontend requests go through FastAPI to diagnostics and persistent PostgreSQL. Diagnostic intelligence retrieves filtered technical evidence and uses OpenAI. A separate MCP pathway queries eBay for transient offers with unknown fitment. TecDoc is pending access and adapter implementation.
svg.text: Dashboard · diagnosis · reports · history · Parts · My Vehicle
360° GLB / Engine Bay photo · typed REST client · explicit state refresh
Vehicle / conversation / diagnostic services · Pydantic validation
Resolve / reopen cases · current urgency = highest across active cases
Validated output · request IDs · HTTP / RAG / MCP timing · health checks
Neon · async SQLAlchemy / psycopg · Alembic · Vite :5174 / Uvicorn :8002
eBay offers stay in Parts: no saved reports, model context or persistent browser storage.
Golf Plus 2009 · 2.0 TDI · CFFB · diesel / manual
No general login, distributed tracing or deployment platform is implied.
